title: [C&C] Smart Tribute Jars
pill_text: SMART TIP JAR & LEADERBOARD • SECOND LIFE 2026
description: Gamified smart tip jar rewarding submissives with +XP and Gold Coins on tribute, custom tip buttons, particle celebrations, Discord webhook alerts, and split revenue.

features.title: Custom Fast-Pay Buttons
features.desc: Presets for fast payment (e.g. L$100, L$500, L$1,000, L$5,000).

features.title: Discord Webhook Pings
features.desc: Instant rich embed notifications in Discord whenever a tribute is paid.

features.title: Particle Pyrotechnics
features.desc: Golden champagne coin showers on high-value donations.

features.title: Split Revenue Shares
features.desc: Built-in automatic split payment to partner, sim owner, or co-domme.

sections.title: 1. Rezzing & Sim Setup
sections.content: Rezz the **[C&C] Smart Tribute Jar** at your skybox, club, or sim parcel. Click the jar to grant debit permissions so it can process payouts and splits.

sections.title: 2. Webhook & XP Integration
sections.content: Enter your Discord webhook URL in `config.notecard`. All tributes will immediately trigger live notifications with donor avatar name, amount, and message.

specs.contents: Gold Velvet Jar Mesh, Particle Scripts, Notecard Config
